{{Quote|Hi there! I'm the Meatlump King's personal chef. He is very particular in what he eats and drinks.|Chef Schlump, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MTP" />}}
[[Chef/Legends|Chef]] '''Schlump''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Meatlumps|Meatlump]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], she served as the personal chef of the [[Meatlump King]]. Schlump worked in the kitchen of the [[Meatlump Hideout]] beneath [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] and [[Schlap]] worked as her assistant chef. Her specialty was obviously [[Meatlump (food)|meatlumps]], the favorite food of the King.<ref name="SWG:MTP" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer who had infiltrated the Meatlump Hideout requested food from Chef Schlump for the starving Meatlump map maker in order to obtain the locations of secret Meatlump camps on Corellia.<ref name="SWG:FLftMM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find Lunch for the Map Maker|Corellia}}</ref> Chef Schlump also tasked the spacer to squash rodents, [[worrmp]]s and [[meetle]]s, in the hideout and collect their juices to produce [[Meatlump wine]].<ref name="SWG:WO">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Wine-O}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Schlump was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MTP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Schlump was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Meatlumps Theme Park|Meatlumps Theme Park]]," introduced with "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>
